semantics: SCMI Clock PROTOCOL_ATTRIBUTES keeps the global 198-clock ID space.
CLOCK_GET_PERMISSIONS reports source-derived per-agent mutation permissions.
Unassigned clocks remain globally addressable for read-only discovery but are marked restricted.
Clock rate, configuration and parent mutations are denied when the generated agent permission is absent.
Clock permission equivalence is functional evidence; physical clock rates, parent topology, enable delays and timing remain hardware-correlation gates.
SCMI Pinctrl PROTOCOL_ATTRIBUTES keeps the global 140-pin inventory.
Valid pin attributes and settings remain globally addressable for read-only discovery.
Pin configuration and request operations require source-derived EXCLUSIVE-or-higher pin permission.
Daisy configuration requires an independently source-derived EXCLUSIVE-or-higher daisy permission.
Pinctrl functional state does not prove pad electrical behavior, mux side effects, ownership timing or signal propagation.

fusa_priority_first_slice.qualification_boundary: Functional M7 FuSa state/subscription and priority queue/channel behavior only. Physical fault generation, fault commands, safety reaction timing and interrupt latency remain open.

notifications.ordering: FIFO while the normal P2A channel is busy

bbm_notification_delivery.qualification_boundary: Functional source-derived subscription, payload, queue ordering and GSR pending-state evidence only. Physical RTC/button event generation, AP/M7 interrupt routing latency and timing correlation remain open.

misc_first_slice.qualification_boundary: Physical fuse-derived numeric silicon fields remain zero; COMBO_PHY is stateful functional control only and does not claim PHY electrical equivalence.

pinned_not_yet_advertised.name: RESET
pinned_not_yet_advertised.reason: The Linux-visible i.MX952 target contract does not expose this protocol; exact EVK reset-domain permissions must be established before optional advertisement.

pinned_not_yet_advertised.name: VOLTAGE
pinned_not_yet_advertised.reason: The Linux-visible i.MX952 target contract does not expose this protocol; exact EVK voltage-domain permissions must be established before optional advertisement.

model_refactor_requirements: Represent SCMI agent identity explicitly instead of treating all A55 channels as one generic agent.
Apply agent-specific permissions before returning domain/resource attributes or accepting state changes.
Use the exact seven-channel mx952evk SMT topology for A2P, P2A notification and M7 priority transport.
Use source-derived domain and resource IDs instead of synthetic sequential names.
Advertise a protocol through Base discovery only when its implemented resource contract is available to that agent.
Keep protocol behavior and permissions traceable to the pinned generated configuration.
Regenerate and compare the exact clock permission map from the pinned NXP source on every qualification run.
Preserve the global 198-clock ID space while enforcing source-derived per-agent mutation permissions and restricted attributes.
Regenerate and compare the exact Pinctrl pin/daisy permission map from the pinned NXP source on every qualification run.
Preserve the global 140-pin inventory while enforcing independent source-derived pin and daisy mutation permissions.
Keep FuSa 0x83 M7-only and validate its independent pinned priority contract on every qualification run.
Preserve separate normal and priority P2A paths; FuSa priority events must remain ordered while channel 2 is busy.
Preserve source-derived BBM RTC/button subscriptions and normal P2A FIFO ordering on M7 channel 1 and AP-NS channel 3.
Do not route BBM events through the FuSa priority queue.
Do not treat deterministic FuSa or BBM triggers as production i.MX952 registers or physical event sources.
Do not convert SET-only sensor permissions into read access.
Do not convert AP-NS LMM NOTIFY permission into lifecycle-control permission.
Do not expose AP-S to BBM because the pinned EVK configuration grants no BBM resources.
Do not expose MISC controls beyond explicit generated-config permissions; first-slice AP-NS access is COMBO_PHY only.
Do not fabricate physical fuse-derived MISC silicon fields; keep unmeasured numeric fields zero until EVK evidence exists.
Keep deterministic sensor, RTC, button, reset-reason, pin state, FuSa state and logical-machine timing/state inputs classified as functional-model evidence until correlated with the physical EVK.
Keep modeled P2A delivery separate from interrupt-latency and cycle-accuracy claims.
